# Examina

> AI quiz generator at https://www.examina.ink

Examina turns any text into multiple choice, flashcard, fill-in-the-blank, and true/false questions in seconds. Upload PDF, paste notes, or photograph handouts to generate practice quizzes with explanations and Bloom's taxonomy mapping.

## Key Features

- **AI question generation** from notes, PDFs, Markdown, or plain text (50-15,000 characters)
- **Multiple question types**: multiple choice, flashcards, fill-in-the-blank, true/false
- **Bloom's taxonomy tagging**: every question tagged Remember → Evaluate
- **29 languages** supported for generation
- **Live classroom mode**: students join with codes, no accounts needed
- **Spaced repetition** study mode with streak tracking
- **Share quizzes** via unique links; PDF export on paid plans
- **OCR support** for handwritten or photographed notes

## For Teachers

- Generate formative assessments (exit tickets, do-nows) in under 30 seconds from lesson notes
- Run live classroom quiz games (Kahoot-style join codes and leaderboards)
- Team plan: unlimited quizzes for up to 5 teachers, shared question banks
- Export quizzes to PDF or share links for homework

## For Students

- Turn study notes into practice quizzes instantly
- Study mode with spaced repetition (SM-2 algorithm)
- Track scores and streaks across multiple attempts
- Generate quizzes for SAT, ACT, AP, MCAT, NCLEX, GRE, LSAT, TOEFL, IELTS prep

## Pricing

- **Free**: 10 quiz generations/month, all question types, sharing, PDF export, no credit card
- **Starter**: $2/month for 20 quizzes
- **Plus**: $5/month for 60 quizzes
- **Pro**: $10/month for 200 quizzes
- **Team**: $15/month for unlimited quizzes, 5 members

Halloween 2026 sale: 20% off all paid plans until Oct 31, 2026.

## Tech Stack

Next.js 16 (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Turso (libSQL), NextAuth.js, DeepSeek AI, Stripe, Tesseract.js OCR, Vercel hosting.

## Use Cases

**Teachers**: daily formative assessment, exit tickets, live classroom games, differentiated question banks
**Students**: exam prep (SAT/ACT/AP/MCAT/NCLEX), study from lecture notes, spaced repetition flashcards
**Tutors**: custom practice tests for individual students
**Corporate training**: L&D quiz creation from training materials
